title: Consecutive Out-of-Stock Days
scenario: Find items that have been out of stock for 5 or more consecutive days.
tableSchema: inventory (item_id INT, stock_date DATE, qty INT)
hint: Create groups using date minus row number.
correctQuery: SELECT item_id FROM (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS outage_len FROM (SELECT item_id, (stock_date - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY stock_date)::INT) AS grp FROM inventory WHERE qty = 0) t GROUP BY item_id, grp) t2 WHERE outage_len >= 5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE inventory (item_id INT, stock_date DATE, qty INT);
